fact: The IOM assessment (mission October 2022) says Eswatini has processes in place for a government interoperability framework (GIF) and recommends concrete steps on the submitted GIF proposal and its timely approval by the cabinet, so it was a submitted proposal and not yet adopted.

The Office of the Executive Secretary, e-Governance published the Eswatini e-Government Interoperability Framework v1.0 (cover January 2025), with a publishing date of March 2025, setting technical policies and standards for how government systems interconnect and exchange data.
